nodes.name: Media Webhook
nodes.notes:
DRAFT-TIME MEDIA UPLOAD
POST /webhook/site/media-npj
Authorization: Bearer <matrix token>
Body: { filename, mimetype, contentBase64, title? }
Stores the image in the hyphae.social Matrix media repo and returns { ok, mxc, filename }.
The mxc:// uri is what the draft article references. Migration to archive.org happens at publish via site/media-archive-npj.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: 'unauthorized', user: $json.user_id || null, role: $json.role || null }) }}

nodes.name: Matrix Media Upload
nodes.notes: Stores bytes in the Matrix content repository. Returns { content_uri: 'mxc://hyphae.social/<id>' }.

nodes.name: Media Archive Webhook
nodes.notes:
PUBLISH-TIME MEDIA MIGRATION (one media per call)
POST /webhook/site/media-archive-npj
Authorization: Bearer <matrix token>
Body: { mxc, identifier, filename, mimetype?, title? }
Server pulls the bytes from the Matrix media repo by mxc, then PUTs to archive.org.
Returns { ok, url } where url is the permanent archive.org download URL to swap in for the mxc.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: ($json.authorized ? 'invalid or missing mxc' : 'unauthorized'), user: $json.user_id || null, role: $json.role || null }) }}

nodes.name: MArc Fetch Bytes
nodes.notes: Authenticated Matrix media download. Returns the bytes as binary field 'data'.

nodes.name: MArc IA Put
nodes.notes: Uses IA S3 keys from n8n env vars IA_S3_ACCESS / IA_S3_SECRET (archive.org/account/s3.php). Never hard-code keys here — a committed workflow JSON is public.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: $json.ok, url: $json.url, error: $json.error, identifier: $json.identifier, filename: $json.filename }) }}

nodes.name: Source Webhook
nodes.notes:
DRAFT-TIME SOURCE DOCUMENT UPLOAD (redaction-gated)
POST /webhook/site/source-npj
Authorization: Bearer <matrix token>
Body: multipart with one binary file + JSON fields:
  kind: source|dataset|document|media (default source)
  filename, title, description, license (default CC-BY-4.0), tags, mime
  parent_identifier?, research_id?
  redactions?: [{type:'text-replace',find,replace}] | [{type:'csv-cell',row,col,replacement}]
  consent_acknowledged: ['permanence','privacy','rights'] (required)
Goes Matrix-auth -> validate+consent -> Apply Redactions -> archive.org.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: 'unauthorized', user: $json.user_id || null, role: $json.role || null }) }}

nodes.name: Publish Webhook
nodes.notes:
PUBLISH (article -> GitHub live CMS + archive.org backup mirror)
POST /webhook/site/publish-npj
Authorization: Bearer <matrix token>
Body: { filename:'articles/<slug>.jsonl', mode:'append'|'overwrite', contentRaw, message, compress?, mirror?:true }
Commits to clovenbradshaw-ctrl/npj (main) then mirrors a snapshot to archive.org.
